# Boost.PFR

This directory vendors the Boost.PFR headers used by binary persistence.

- Upstream: https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/1_83_0/doc/html/boost_pfr.html
- Version: Boost 1.83.0
- License: Boost Software License 1.0; see `LICENSE_1_0.txt`

Only `boost/pfr.hpp` and the `boost/pfr` header tree are included.
